title: Add targeted anti-forgery and bootstrap hardening for auth/setup flows
description:
Problem: setup and login form flows are anonymous endpoints and currently rely on ambient browser protections plus deployment assumptions.

Desired outcome: reduce cross-site request risk while preserving bootstrap and local login usability.

Scope:
- In scope: targeted anti-forgery and/or equivalent request-origin protections for setup/login form flows, plus explicit bootstrap hardening options.
- Out of scope: redesign of full authentication architecture.

Acceptance criteria:
- Setup/login form flows include explicit request validation protections with a documented compatibility path.
- Bootstrap path remains functional for intended localhost onboarding scenarios.
- Security and UX guidance clearly explains opt-in exceptions.

Validation:
- Add tests for protected form flows and setup compatibility conditions.
- Verify first-admin setup succeeds under documented secure path and fails under invalid path.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from security audit finding F-004 with explicit compatibility guard to avoid workflow regressions.
